quarterly_data.quarter: Quantum-Si press release: Quantum-Si Presents Interim Proteus Data at World HUPO 2026 (09-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Quantum-Si reported interim development results comparing Proteus with its commercially available Platinum Pro, using a developmental sequencing kit that detects 18 amino acids, while the Proteus instrument, consumable, loading protocol and analysis software are still in development and not yet fully optimized. In a control peptide study (n = 4 runs per platform), Proteus delivered a median of 30 times more alignments than Platinum Pro from a single chamber, identified all six control peptides in every run and achieved a 4.8-fold lower median false discovery rate (1.36% versus 6.58%); the company projects a full four-chamber Proteus run could deliver approximately 60 times more alignments than a two-chamber Platinum Pro run. In protein mixtures prepared with a commercial library prep kit, Proteus identified 1.6 to 2.0 times more peptides. In a 24-protein panel not previously sequenced on either platform, Proteus detected all 24 proteins versus an average of 20.3 on Platinum Pro and detected 4.3 times more amino acids per run, including cysteine and histidine, which were detected only on Proteus. CEO: Proteus is a fundamentally superior platform technology, not simply a larger version of Platinum Pro, and the company expects further improvements ahead of launch.
